_comment: Canonical registry of agent-support modules for the C5 / Hermes swarm. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — read by both the dashboard (src import) and the local helper (tools/agent-modules-helper.py). Add a module by appending an entry here; the tab and helper pick it up automatically. updateCmd is an ALLOWLIST — the helper only ever runs the exact updateCmd for a known id, never arbitrary input.

modules.name: LiteParse
modules.description: Local PDF/DOCX/image → markdown parser (Rust core). Powers parse_document() in the SuperAgent swarm. Zero LLM tokens, no cloud, no GPU.

modules.name: Wrangler
modules.description: Cloudflare Workers CLI — deploys gaw-mod-proxy and cc-proxy. The swarm's edge-deploy tool.

modules.name: yt-dlp
modules.description: YouTube transcript/media extractor behind pm-yt-helper (POST MASTER ingestion).

modules.name: Firecrawl (py)
modules.description: URL → clean markdown scraper used by superagent_lib.firecrawl_scrape().

modules.name: sentence-transformers
modules.description: Embedding models (bge) powering zvec-rag dense semantic search + the CAT CHOIR contestedness layer.

modules.name: Zvec
modules.description: On-disk vector store backing zvec-rag (durable, metadata-filterable RAG).

modules.name: Playwright (py)
modules.description: Headless browser automation; CloakBrowser drop-in + e2e flows.
